ui.整体效果已关闭 · 全部回到游戏原版（数值都留着）: Overall effect OFF · back to vanilla (values kept)
ui.切换这个参数的写法：绝对 / 比例（原值 × %） / 偏移（原值 + Δ）: Switch mode: Absolute / Ratio (orig × %) / Offset (orig + Δ)

groupdesc.雾效: Fog intensity and volumetric fog settings.
groupdesc.光照与色调: Exposure / local exposure / tone mapping / color grading / ambient occlusion. These depend on the in-game graphics preset and may not apply at low presets.
groupdesc.分辨率（窗口）: The game's own resolution interface is stubbed, so this resizes the game window directly and UE rebuilds the render target itself. Independent of the master switch.

fog.density.label: Fog Density
fog.density.hint: Master control for overall fog density; 100% = game default.

fog.maxopacity.label: Fog Max Opacity (%)
fog.maxopacity.hint: Maximum fog opacity; lower it to thin out dense haze.

fog.start.label: Fog Start Distance (m)
fog.start.hint: Classic fog start distance; pushes fog away from the camera.

fog.extinction.label: Volumetric Fog Extinction
fog.extinction.hint: How quickly volumetric fog fades with distance.

fog.heightfall.label: Height Falloff
fog.heightfall.hint: How quickly fog thins out with height.

fog.voldist.label: Volumetric Fog Distance
fog.voldist.hint: Max distance at which volumetric fog is computed.

fog.vstart.label: Volumetric Fog - Start Distance
fog.vstart.hint: Where volumetric fog begins; push near-field room haze away (e.g. 5 m).

fog.vnearfade.label: Volumetric Fog - Near Fade-in
fog.vnearfade.hint: Fade-in length before volumetric fog reaches full strength.

img.bloomthr.label: Bloom Threshold
img.bloomthr.hint: Brightness above which bloom kicks in.

img.bloompfmax.label: Bloom Prefilter Max Brightness
img.bloompfmax.hint: Upper brightness limit for the bloom prefilter.

gi.evup.label: Exposure Speed Up
gi.evup.hint: How fast exposure rises when getting brighter.

gi.evdown.label: Exposure Speed Down
gi.evdown.hint: How fast exposure falls when getting darker.

gi.lowpct.label: Ignore Dark (%)
gi.lowpct.hint: Fraction of darkest pixels ignored in metering.

gi.highpct.label: Ignore Bright (%)
gi.highpct.hint: Fraction of brightest pixels ignored in metering.

gi.lekernel.label: Local Exposure - Blur Kernel (%)
gi.lekernel.hint: Blur kernel size for local exposure.

gi.localexpmode.label: Local Exposure Method (0 Off / 1 Bilateral / 2 Gaussian)

img.expandgamut.label: Gamut Expansion (ACES-like)
img.expandgamut.hint: Expand color gamut for a filmic look.

gi.skyleakdist.label: Leak Distance (cm)
gi.skyleakdist.hint: Distance over which skylight leaking reaches full strength.

res.mode.label: Resolution (Window Size)
res.mode.hint: Applying this resizes the window; independent of the master switch.
